value.rationale: The exact rational Gauss-bijection invariant refines tangent-filling in the projective plane and is motivated by point/tangent interpolation in Asgarli–Ghioca. The sequence 24/0/3048 at the first consecutive smooth plane-filling degrees shows a nonmonotone gap; its complete sextic projective-orbit classification is an arithmetic geometric classification, not a stand-alone routine toy count.
